fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Thermodynamic Cycle with Boiler-Drum ODE
description: First-principles Rankine cycle: boiler/superheater, turbine (isentropic efficiency), condenser, feed pump. States and thermal efficiency from simplified IAPWS-IF97 water/steam correlations. Lumped boiler-drum temperature ODE via scipy.solve_ivp. Optional reheat and regenerative feedwater heating.
source: Moran & Shapiro (2014) Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics 8th ed., Ch.8; Cengel & Boles (2015) Thermodynamics 8th ed., Ch.10; IAPWS-IF97 (Wagner et al. 2000, J. Eng. Gas Turbines Power 122:150-184)
